sections.title: باب 4 — متن (10)

paras.text: … adopted. Talks began between the two countries, and after detailed negotiation they reached an agreement. North Korea agreed to stop its atomic programme, in exchange for which America and Japan jointly gave North Korea two atomic reactors. A decade later this agreement fell into danger when the world began to say that North Korea has the capability to make atomic weapons.

paras.text: Between the Palestinians and Israel, war has been going on for a long time over the establishment of a Palestinian state. In this war both parties have suffered severe financial and human losses. The Israeli army is attacking Palestinians, while Palestinian armed organisations are targeting Israel. Through the mediation of the American government, in 1993 negotiations began in Oslo (Norway) between Palestinian representatives and Israel. After long negotiations both parties agreed on a declaration of principles. In it the Palestinian leadership (Yasser Arafat) recognised Israel, and Israel showed willingness for the phased transfer of power in the Palestinian-majority areas. This negotiation was continued, and after the agreements of 1994-95, under the leadership of Mahmoud Abbas, the Palestinian National Authority was established. The Palestinians were given autonomy in the Gaza Strip and some parts of the West Bank of the River Jordan. After this, talks began between Jordan and Israel and an agreement took place between the two countries.

North Korea agreed to stop its atomic programme, in exchange for which America and Japan jointly gave North Korea two atomic reactors. A decade later this agreement fell into danger when the world began to say that North Korea has the capability to make atomic weapons.

Between the Palestinians and Israel, war has been going on for a long time over the establishment of a Palestinian state. In this war both parties have suffered severe financial and human losses. The Israeli army is attacking Palestinians, while Palestinian armed organisations are targeting Israel. Through the mediation of the American government, in 1993 negotiations began in Oslo (Norway) between Palestinian representatives and Israel. After long negotiations both parties agreed on a declaration of principles. In it the Palestinian leadership (Yasser Arafat) recognised Israel, and Israel showed willingness for the phased transfer of power in the Palestinian-majority areas. This negotiation was continued, and after the agreements of 1994-95, under the leadership of Mahmoud Abbas, the Palestinian National Authority was established. The Palestinians were given autonomy in the Gaza Strip and some parts of the West Bank of the River Jordan. After this, talks began between Jordan and Israel and an agreement took place between the two countries.

The disputes after the Pak-India war of 1965 were resolved through negotiation and the mediation of the Soviet Union by means of the Tashkent agreement. The disputes after the Pak-India war of 1971 were resolved through mutual talks of the leadership of the two countries in the Indian city of Simla.

sections.title: باب 4 — متن (11)

paras.text: … are created in the way of freedom-lovers, severe problems are born. The countries from which freedom is sought become the biggest cause of problems. Freedom-lovers are crushed; human rights are violated and inhuman activities are carried out, because of which the issue takes on further severity. Then world institutions and great powers are made party, and remaining impartial causes further ruin. For example, the people of Chechnya want to obtain freedom from Russia, but Russia wants to crush the freedom movement. The people of Bosnia and Kosovo, through financial and human sacrifices, obtained freedom from the former Yugoslavia. The people of Palestine are passing through indescribable hardships in the effort to obtain freedom from Israel. The people of Nagorno-Karabakh, with the help of Armenia, are struggling to obtain freedom from Azerbaijan. These movements have a deep effect on world relations.
paras.urdu: پیدا کی جاتی ہیں تو شدید مسائل جنم لیتے ہیں۔ جن ممالک سے آزادی حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کی جاتی ہے وہی ملک مسائل کا سب سے بڑا سبب ہوتے ہیں۔ حریت پسندوں کو کچلا جاتا ہے؛ اِنسانی حقوق کی خلاف ورزیاں کی جاتی ہیں اور غیر اِنسانی سرگرمیاں کی جاتی ہیں جن کی وجہ سے مسئلہ مزید شدت اختیار کر جاتا ہے۔ پھر عالمی اِداروں اور بڑی طاقتوں کا فریق بنایا جانا یا غیر جانبدار رہنا مزید بربادی کا سبب بنتا ہے۔ مثال کے طور پر چیچنیا کے عوام روس سے آزادی حاصل کرنا چاہتے ہیں لیکن روس حریت کی تحریک کو کچلنا چاہتا ہے۔ سابقہ یوگوسلاویہ سے بوسنیا اور کوسوو نے مالی و جانی قربانی دے کر آزادی حاصل کی۔ فلسطین کے لوگ اِسرائیل سے آزادی حاصل کرنے کی کوشش میں ناقابلِ بیان مصائب سے گزر رہے ہیں۔ نگورنو کاراباغ کے لوگ آرمینیاء کی مدد سے آذربائیجان سے آزادی حاصل کرنے کی جدوجہد کر رہے ہیں۔ اِن تحریکوں کا عالمی تعلقات پر گہرا اثر ہے۔

paras.text: After the First World War, in the Treaty of Versailles and the United Nations charter, nations were given the right to decide their political future, which is called the right of self-determination. When some nations want to use this right, the nations occupying those areas do not recognise this right of those people. In this way world problems are born. For example, the United Nations, through a resolution, gave the people of Kashmir the right of self-determination, but India does not let them use this right.

paras.text: Behind most conflicts there is the issue of ownership of territory. Pak-India wars too have generally taken place over territorial conflicts. In the same way, the basic issue between the people of Palestine and the Israeli government is territorial. The Iraq–Iran war too took place over a particular region, i.e. Shatt al-Arab. Another important cause was resources. The war between Iraq and Kuwait was basically over ownership of oil. … are created in the way of freedom-lovers, severe problems are born. The countries from which freedom is sought become the biggest cause of problems. Freedom-lovers are crushed; human rights are violated and inhuman activities are carried out, because of which the issue takes on further severity. Then world institutions and great powers are made party, and remaining impartial causes further ruin. For example, the people of Chechnya want to obtain freedom from Russia, but Russia wants to crush the freedom movement. The people of Bosnia and Kosovo, through financial and human sacrifices, obtained freedom from the former Yugoslavia. The people of Palestine are passing through indescribable hardships in the effort to obtain freedom from Israel. The people of Nagorno-Karabakh, with the help of Armenia, are struggling to obtain freedom from Azerbaijan. These movements have a deep effect on world relations.

After the First World War, in the Treaty of Versailles and the United Nations charter, nations were given the right to decide their political future, which is called the right of self-determination. When some nations want to use this right, the nations occupying those areas do not recognise this right of those people. In this way world problems are born. For example, the United Nations, through a resolution, gave the people of Kashmir the right of self-determination, but India does not let them use this right.

… are created in the way of freedom-lovers, severe problems are born. The countries from which freedom is sought become the biggest cause of problems. Freedom-lovers are crushed; human rights are violated and inhuman activities are carried out, because of which the issue takes on further severity. Then world institutions and great powers are made party, and remaining impartial causes further ruin. For example, the people of Chechnya want to obtain freedom from Russia, but Russia wants to crush the freedom movement. The people of Bosnia and Kosovo, through financial and human sacrifices, obtained freedom from the former Yugoslavia. The people of Palestine are passing through indescribable hardships in the effort to obtain freedom from Israel. The people of Nagorno-Karabakh, with the help of Armenia, are struggling to obtain freedom from Azerbaijan. These movements have a deep effect on world relations.

After the First World War, in the Treaty of Versailles and the United Nations charter, nations were given the right to decide their political future, which is called the right of self-determination. When some nations want to use this right, the nations occupying those areas do not recognise this right of those people. In this way world problems are born. For example, the United Nations, through a resolution, gave the people of Kashmir the right of self-determination, but India does not let them use this right.

Behind most conflicts there is the issue of ownership of territory. Pak-India wars too have generally taken place over territorial conflicts. In the same way, the basic issue between the people of Palestine and the Israeli government is territorial. The Iraq–Iran war too took place over a particular region, i.e. Shatt al-Arab. Another important cause was resources. The war between Iraq and Kuwait was basically over ownership of oil. At this time between some Central Asian countries, Russia and Iran, there is an issue over ownership of the Caspian Sea, because this sea is the biggest lake of the world, which is full of natural resources. Among most countries of the world there is an unhealthy competition for economic resources and dominance in world trade, which can become the cause of conflict at any place.

Most world conflicts are based on internal civil war or rebellions. Sri Lanka remained a victim of civil war for a long time. An organisation named the Tamil Tigers had made life there a burden. Among the causes of world conflicts, the negative attitude and behaviour of great powers is also at work. In international relations great powers are needed to play a proper role in creating pleasantness, but these countries conduct international relations in the light of their own interests, which create problems, despair, deprivation …
